draft.text: You came in because you have had a cold for about a week.
You have symptoms like postnasal drip and congestion in your upper chest area.
Your vital signs, including temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, and blood pressure, were normal.
You have a cold with a dry cough, no shortness of breath, no fever, and no significant chest pain.
You have no history of respiratory conditions, smoking, or exposure to irritants.
The next steps will be discussed.
